name: inspect_evm_interface
description: Inspect an explicit local flat EVM bytecode carrier and infer dispatch selectors, argument strings and mutability without executing the target or accessing a chain/RPC endpoint. Choose raw or hex encoding explicitly. Returns original carrier and decoded-byte SHA-256, full bytecode and interface candidates inline as inferred Evidence; bytecode kind, hardfork, deployed authenticity and discovery completeness remain unknown. Initial real-verified Linux x64 profile uses unchanged bundled EVMole 0.9.3/WASM in a bounded owned worker; EOF-style EF00 containers are unsupported. No signature lookup, wallet action or transaction broadcast.

__schema0.description: Absolute path to caller-selected local bytecode carrier

__schema1.description: Raw bytes or UTF-8 hex with optional 0x prefix and outer ASCII whitespace

encoding.description: Raw bytes or UTF-8 hex with optional 0x prefix and outer ASCII whitespace

path.description: Absolute path to caller-selected local bytecode carrier
